products.name: BLDC Ultra-Quiet Ceiling Fan
products.shortDesc: Brushless DC motor with RF remote control, aerodynamically balanced blades and 28W ultra-low power consumption.
products.description: Engineered for silent, high air-delivery operation. The smart brushless DC motor consumes merely 28 watts at top speed, saving up to ₹1,800 annually on electricity compared to conventional induction fans.

products.name: Frost-Free Inverter Refrigerator (265L)
products.shortDesc: Double-door convertible refrigerator with smart digital inverter compressor and multi-airflow deodorizer.
products.description: Equipped with an intelligent inverter compressor that auto-tunes its cooling speed according to cooling demand. Keeps vegetables crisp for up to 15 days with 0.5 kWh daily energy footprint.

products.name: Dual Inverter Split Air Conditioner (AC 1.5 Ton)
products.shortDesc: Copper condenser coil with anti-corrosion blue-fin coating, 6-in-1 convertible cooling and PM 2.5 air filter.
products.description: Rapidly cools rooms even under extreme 52°C outdoor heat. The dual-rotary inverter compressor adjusts motor speed dynamically, dropping electricity usage by up to 40% compared to non-inverter models.

products.name: Smart Inverter Front-Load Washing Machine (7.5 kg)
products.shortDesc: Fully automatic front-load with Steam Hygiene wash, stainless steel diamond drum, and built-in water heater.
products.description: Designed to tackle stubborn stains with gentle fabric care. Inverter direct-drive motor delivers high spin efficiency of 1400 RPM while minimizing vibration, noise, and water consumption.

products.name: 4K Ultra HD Smart LED TV (43-inch)
products.shortDesc: Bezel-less cinema display with Dolby Audio, HDR10+, Dual-Band Wi-Fi, and Google TV voice control.
products.description: Immersive entertainment experience with vivid 4K resolution (3840x2160) and 24W box stereo speakers. Features low blue-light eye protection and energy-saving standby mode under 0.5W.
specs: Google TV OS with Play Store

products.name: Heavy-Duty 750W Mixer Grinder (3 Jars)
products.shortDesc: Pure copper armature motor with 3 stainless steel leak-proof jars and auto-shutoff overload protection.
products.description: Grinds hard ingredients like turmeric, coffee beans, and soaked pulses with ease. Equipped with multi-utility stainless steel blades and dual exhaust vents for cooler motor operation.

products.name: RO + UV + MTDS Alkaline Water Purifier
products.shortDesc: 8-stage water purifier with copper-zinc infusion, TDS controller, and 8.5-liter food-grade storage tank.
products.description: Removes dissolved impurities, heavy metals, bacteria, and microplastics while replenishing essential alkaline minerals for healthy drinking water. Features smart LED tank full and filter change alerts.
specs: Suitable for Borewell & Municipal Water (up to 2000 TDS)

products.name: Desert Air Cooler with Honeycomb Pads (55L)
products.shortDesc: High-throw motorized louvers with dense antibacterial honeycomb pads and built-in ice chamber.
products.description: Delivers high-velocity cooling for living rooms and terraces up to 350 sq ft. The low 185W power consumption allows it to run smoothly on home inverters during power outages.

products.name: Non-Stick Dry & Steam Electric Iron
products.shortDesc: Heavy golden American heritage non-stick soleplate with 360-degree swivel cord and multi-fabric temperature dial.
products.description: Glide effortlessly across silk, cotton, and denim without sticking or burning. The instant heating dual element heats in seconds, automatically cutting off power when preset temperatures are reached.

products.name: Convection Microwave Oven with Grill (28L)
products.shortDesc: Multi-stage cooking with baking, grilling, reheating, and 200+ auto-cook Indian menu presets.
products.description: Prepare crispy tandoori rotis, bake cakes, or defrost meals in minutes. The durable ceramic enamel cavity is antibacterial, scratch-resistant, and effortless to wipe clean.
